subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, replace it with an upstream OpenClaw PR, or wait for the contributor to refresh it?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and small, but the active candidate is an external fork PR, so automation should not queue a duplicate fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or Review the Fork PR
options.body: Review the external fork candidate and adopt it into the target repository if the patch still fits current main.

options.title: Replace Upstream
options.body: Open a narrow OpenClaw PR that applies the same central label normalization and regression coverage directly on current main.

options.title: Wait for Contributor Refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the external contributor to refresh the candidate before maintainer adoption.

recommendation.title: Adopt or Review the Fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the external fork candidate and adopt it into the target repository if the patch still fits current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior ClawSweeper routing and recent adjacent bootstrap-helper history point to this person as the best available maintainer-facing reviewer for the adoption decision.
